text:
La Gazzetta dello Sport
McTominay relaunches Napoli and Allegri: Toro fight but crumble.
Attack to Inter
Noslin and Malen show: the defending champions are under pressure
Unbeatable Lazio, they knock Lecce down. Roma sit second: four goals in Parma, with four goals from the top scorer. Chivu forced to beat Atalanta at 20:45 to respond to the capital’s attack.
Cardinale calls Endrick
‘The Brazilian is the top; Rabiot will extend.’ Como’s overtake: they are fourth.
Spalletti challenges Conte: ‘I studied the colleagues when I didn’t have a team.’
Corriere dello Sport
Lazio fun
GTAttuso 32
Marvellous Noslin: +2 on Gasp and +4 on Chivu, who challenges Sarri today.
Tenth win and Tijjani’s brace: six goals in 11 games. Then, a new Frattesi magic, who has now scored five. Rino: ‘There’s sense of belonging here, my only merit is to have created a family.’ Inter in Bergamo with Thuram.
Mamma, what a Malen!
Roma sit second: 5-1 win over Parma with four goals from the Dutchman
Immense Donyell. A superb goal average: 15 games, 12 Serie A goals, four in the Champions League. Applause for Mora too—fourth consecutive goal. Como beat Cagliari 2-0 with Ramon and Da Cunha.
The usual McT, Napoli unlocked
Great saves from Perri, then Scott deals with it. Vergara’s muscle injury.
‘Conte? It’s normal to have hope.’
Lucio with Kolo Muani and Alajbegovic behind Woltemade (12:30).
Tuttosport
Toro end Napoli’s crisis
As usual, in the Cairo era, the Granata will go nowhere. The coach had announced boldness: defence, big Perri saves, some chance on the counter, Mandragora hitting the crossbar, then the inevitable surrender. Allegri breathes and catches Juve.
Lucio and Conte on the Juve ring
The Bianconeri coach after Antonio’s auto-candidacy: ‘It’s normal that a coach without a team hopes to sit on an important bench such as those of Milan, Manchester United and Juventus. Would I have said the same? When I didn’t have a team, I used to visit my colleagues to learn. McKennie? He came to explain.’ Ibra charges Alajbegovic.
Noslin, the flying Dutchman
Spectacular brace and Frattesi’s magic: Gattuso runs away and puts pressure on Inter, who play in Bergamo tonight.
Malen, the fantastic four!
The other Dutchman in the capital is scary: four goals, all different. Gasp is now second: ‘Only Lautaro is better.’ Mora celebrates too.
Como in Champions League form: Goodbye Cagliari, Milan overtaken
digest_he:
עיתוני הספורט המרכזיים באיטליה מסכמים את אירועי המחזור בליגה. רומא רשמה ניצחון מרשים 5-1 על פארמה בזכות ארבעה שערים של דוניל מאלן ההולנדי. במקביל, לאציו המשיכה בכושר המצוין שלה עם ניצחון נוסף, כשהמאמן רנו גאטוזו מדגיש את תחושת המשפחתיות שנוצרה בקבוצה שעלתה למקום השני.

מנגד, נאפולי חזרה למסלול הניצחונות בזכות שער של סקוט מקטומינאי, וזאת על רקע אמירותיו של המאמן לוצ'יאנו ספאלטי בנוגע למעקב המקצועי אחרי קולגות. אינטר נותרה תחת לחץ לקראת משחקה בברגמו מול אטאלנטה, בעוד קומו ממשיכה להפתיע ומטפסת במעלה הטבלה.
